description: Reaction thermodynamics (dH, dS, dG, K) — Standard reaction enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs energy and equilibrium constant from a chemical equation, using a built-in table of ~55 standard formation values (combustion, ammonia synthesis, limestone calcination, oxides, acids, fuels). Give equation= with optional phases (H2O(l) vs H2O(g)) and fractional coefficients (13/2O2); temp_k= or temp_c= for dG and K at another temperature (dH - T*dS). Checks the atom balance, reports exo/endothermic, spontaneity and the crossover temperature. Add missing species with custom=Formula(phase):dHf_kJ:S_J_per_molK[:dGf_kJ] separated by ;. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_thermo
